shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C 4 'i18n' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; grep -n 'gravity-ui/i18n"' -A5 package-lock.json | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Lang SegmentedRadioGroup Select

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Lang SegmentedRadioGroup Select; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh i18n I18N; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm

rg -n -C4 'i18n|configure|Lang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/ | head -50; rg -ln 'export.*configure' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat utils/configure.d.ts; rg -n 'configure|Lang' index.d.ts; rg -rn 'export.*useLang|subscribeConfigure|lang' components/theme/*.d.ts hooks/*/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cat components/controls/../SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls components | grep -i -E 'segment|radio|select|card|text'

cat components/theme/useLang.d.ts components/theme/types.d.ts | head -80; cat components/theme/index.d.ts; rg -n 'lang' components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -20; rg -n 'interface ControlGroupProps' -A 20 components/types.d.ts; rg -n 'subscribeConfigure|getConfig' components/utils/registerKeyset.* | head
rg -n 'lang|Lang' components/theme/useLang.js utils/configure.js i18n/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls i18n 2>/dev/null; rg -ln 'addComponentKeysets' --glob '*.js' . | head -3

cat components/Select/i18n/en.json components/Select/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null; ls components/Select/i18n; sed -n 1,30p components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; cat ../../../i18n/build/esm/types.d.ts | head -30; rg -n 'filterable|filterPlaceholder|renderEmptyOptions|hasClear|label\??:' components/Select/types.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install @gravity-ui/i18n@^1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -5; grep i18n package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json | grep '"version"'
